start.text: Elder Vaela Thorn. Canipure keeps the east coast, and the boughs face Vaelmoor. You are of the trees, or near enough. High elf and wood elf both. Mossantler is the stag we rarely see. I would like it met. King Aldric Valdor rules the castles west of the forest. He does not rule this city. We still know his name.

outsider.text: Elder Vaela Thorn. You are not of the trees. The stair will bind you, and Moss will sell bread. I do not give the grove's work to outsiders. The halls will not teach you. You may still walk the forest. Be polite while you do.

choices.label: I will keep to the yard.

welcome.text: Wood elves wake here. High elves are kin, and the dock faces their city. Everyone else gets the yard, the stair, and the bread. Not the drills.

hart_active.text: Mossantler. West, where the Greenreach forgets the road. It does not come often.

done.text: The forest will grow another stag. The coast still faces Vaelmoor.

start.text: Sylven Reed. I keep the west bough. The Greenreach is a young forest: hares, beetles, then wolves. Eight green wolves, before you go looking for Puck. The same trees run west, north of Ironhollow Keep, to Blackpine.

outsider.text: Sylven Reed. Cold wind off the sea, and colder for you. This city is for wood elves, and we stand with the high elves. You may bind at the stair and buy what Moss calls bread. The boughs will not train you, and I will not hand you the grove's counts. Walk softly.

wolves_active.text: Eight green wolves. They like the west trail.

wolves_ready.text: Eight. Next is Puck the Snare. He stays down longer than a wolf.

after_wolves.text: Puck the Snare, west of the road. End it.

puck_active.text: Puck is still on the trail.

puck_ready.text: The snare is ended. The elder can have the stag, if you want the rarer job.

done.text: The west trail holds. Ironhollow is that way, then Blackpine. The dock is the other way, toward Vaelmoor.

roads.text: West, the Greenreach, then the forest north of Ironhollow Keep, then Blackpine Tower in Valdoria. King Aldric Valdor rules those castles. East, the dock, and Eldenmoor across the water. The hills south of Ironhollow are the harder road, not this one.

start.text: Moss Linden. Bread, bandages, and the two charts for anyone who can pay. A grove staff and a wood bow are for elves. High elf or wood elf, those are yours to buy.

outsider.text: Moss Linden. I will sell you bread and bandages, and the charts, because a lost traveler is a worse neighbor than a rude one. The grove staff is not for you. The halls are not for you. The stair will still take your bind.

start.text: Oak. The court is safe. The Greenreach is not. If you are not an elf, be brief.

outsider.text: Oak. You can stand there. Do not lean on the boughs like you built them.

start.text: Fern. The dock faces Vaelmoor. The west road is the forest. I watch both.

outsider.text: Fern. Pass. The bread is Moss. The drills are not.

start.text: Larkin Bough. The warden list, the same drills Bjorn sells in Hoffender, through the last of them. Nothing is learned by getting older. If it says Requires level, you are early.

outsider.text: Larkin Bough. I do not teach outside the blood. High elves may buy, because we stand with them. You may not.

start.text: Thistle Venn. Quietly. The rogue list, through level fifty. The line that says Requires level is a closed door.

outsider.text: Thistle Venn. No. The knife is not a souvenir for every traveler King Aldric's road sends east.

start.text: Briar Holt. Druid. A mend, a root, a rot that stays, and a bark you put on yourself. You buy them. Leveling does not hand them over. The list says Requires level N until you are that old.

outsider.text: Briar Holt. The grove does not sell its words to you. Come back as an elf, or do not come back for this.

start.text: Rowan Keel. Ranger. The bow, a knife if they get close, a mark on the trail, and a call that beasts sometimes answer. Bought, not gifted. Through level fifty. Requires level means what it says.

outsider.text: Rowan Keel. The bow stays on the rack. Elves may buy the drills. You get the yard.

start.text: Lord Edric Hollen. Ironhollow Keep is mine to hold, and I hold it for King Aldric Valdor. Every castle lord on Maerthun answers to him. The capital is not built in this yard. Old Marrow is the rare of the south hills. I would like it met.

choices.label: I will look for Old Marrow.

marrow_active.text: Old Marrow. South, off the road, and not often. It stays down when it falls.

marrow_ready.text: You met it. That is the word I owed the king's map.

done.text: The hills will grow another bear. The forest north of us still runs to Canipure. Tell the king's people, if you see them, that the keep stands.

roads.text: North of the keep, one forest: west to Blackpine Tower and Valdoria, east to the Greenreach and Canipure. South, the hills, eighteen to twenty-eight. Wyrmrest is not this road. It is north of Hoffender, under the peaks, and the Grokthul ogres live east of it.

start.text: Sergeant Oswin Keel. The court is safe. The hills are not. Eight hill wolves, before you go naming brigands. Lord Edric answers to King Aldric Valdor. I answer to Lord Edric. That is the whole chain.

wolves_active.text: Eight hill wolves. They like the south slope.

wolves_ready.text: Eight. Rusk the Hollow is next. He takes a toll and he stays down.

after_wolves.text: Rusk the Hollow, with the brigands. End the toll.

rusk_ready.text: The toll is ended. The lord can have the bear.

done.text: The gate holds. North is the forest road. South is the hills.

start.text: Cald Hollen. I work the castle forge for Lord Edric, and he works it for King Aldric Valdor. Plate and chain, at the price on the slate.
Bessa Quill. Rations, bandages, and the two Ironhollow charts. Osric sells Blackpine. I do not. The forest north of the keep is one wood, from his tower to Canipure.

Speaker Grukka. Grokthul Hold is this clan. We fight the dragons the cold woke. We are not Vargan Frostfang's ogres, and we do not want his name on our fire. Eight valley wolves, if you are starting here. King Aldric Valdor's castle is Wyrmrest, west of our peaks. We are neighbors. He is not our king. He is theirs.

which.text: Vargan keeps the Fang, past Hoffender's north road. Hostile, and not us. The Grokthul live in these eastern highlands, beside Wyrmrest, and the things we hunt have scales.

wolves_active.text: Eight valley wolves. South of the palisade.

wolves_ready.text: Eight. Brug the Toll is next. He is not of this clan.

after_wolves.text: Brug the Toll, south, with anyone still paying him. End it.

brug_active.text: Brug is still taking the toll.

brug_ready.text: The toll is ended. The valley can have its rare boar another day. The peaks are Skaal's count.

done.text: The hold stands. North is the peaks, then Wyrmrest to the west. Do not call us Frostfang.

start.text: Skaal. Tuskwatch is the fire on the Grokthul Peaks. West is Wyrmrest. South is the hold, and it is too young for what walks up here. Eight ash drakes. They woke when the Black Ice broke. We were already here.

drakes_active.text: Eight ash drakes. They are the middle of this road, which is not a comfort.

drakes_ready.text: Eight. Cindermaw is the rare one, north. It stays down.

after_drakes.text: Cindermaw. North of the road. End it. The sealed lair under Wyrmrest's spires is not this job.

maw_active.text: Cindermaw is still on the roost.

maw_ready.text: You came back. The fang is the watch's pay, if the roost did not already drop one.

done.text: The peaks are quieter. Wyrmrest still stands west of us. Bind here if you mean to keep hunting scales.

start.text: Bruk. The pit sells the warrior drills, the same list as Hoffender, through level fifty. If it says Requires level, you are early.
Shala. Slows, mends, and the burn that stays. Torunn's list. I sell it here. The level is the lock.
Ruk the Red. Rage is a tool. The pit sells Hroth's list, to the end of it.
Ugga. Rations, the hold charts, and leather that fits a large chest. The peaks chart is Skaal's.
Gash. The yard is safe. The valley is not. Vargan's ogres are a long way west of this fire. Do not mix us up.
Mara. North is the peaks and the dragons. South is where the young ones learn. I count who comes back.
Linden Moss. The druid list, the same one Briar sells in Canipure, through level fifty. Nothing on it arrives because you leveled. If it says Requires level, you are early.
Keel Ash. The ranger list, through the last arrow. Bought. The level on the line is the lock.
